$comment: MCP servers registered at user scope by install.sh via `claude mcp add-json`. Kept separate from plugins.json because MCP definitions live in ~/.claude.json, not settings.json: that file is Claude's own mutable state, so it is written through the CLI rather than symlinked.
$why: firebase and playwright are wanted for their tools only, not their skills. Firebase's plugin bundles ~10 Genkit/Firestore skills alongside the MCP server; the playwright plugin ships a skill and no MCP server at all. Registering the servers directly gives the tools without the skill bloat.

firebase.why: Firestore, Auth, Hosting, App Hosting, deploys. `--dir .` resolves the project from the cwd, so it follows whichever repo the session is in

playwright.why: browser automation as tool calls. Note the playwright-skill plugin never provided this: it only wrote Playwright scripts to /tmp
